title: MV Map Editor tile size help

posts.author: Radri
posts.body:
So I am quite new to rpg maker mv, trying to learn the basics. Instead of using tilesets for maps, I am doing parallax mapping that is on a 40x40 grid instead of maker's 48x48.
So far I was able to fix most issues with tiles and what not but the final obstacle is a map editor. It still displays 48x48 grid so placing something in editor, will make it displaced in the actual game. It makes stuff like placing event tiles more time consuming because I have to test where they will appear in the actual project.
So for example I put my starting position at what seems to be 3,3 in the editor but ingame it spawns me at 0,0.
Is there any plugin that could possibly allow for shrinking the Map Editor visual grid from 48x48?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
No. Plugins can't change the editor, only the game.
If you're really intent on using 40x40 instead of 48x48 for some reason, you'd have to use something like this plugin:
Change Tile Size
Change Tile Size     by Shaz     version 1.1 2016.10.23      Introduction     This plugin allows you to change from the default tile size of 48x48 to something larger or smaller.      How to use     Add to your plugins folder (file name should be ChangeTileSize.js).      Set the Tile Size...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
You'd place the event tiles on the appropriate grid coordinates in the editor.

posts.author: Radri
posts.body: I suppose I will decide between just seeing where event tiles go and respriting tiles to 48x48 then.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
Is it hard to modified your layers instead? It will need more work in the future if your game is still in its early development.
48 is not a bad number for some reason.
1. Many pixel related resources are in the size of multiple of 8.
2. It can be divided by 2,3,4,6,8,12,16 which makes smooth movement easier since by default the events moves from grid to grid.
3. It is Well tested and many plugins are written based on that. Using another values makes it unpredictable and you may need to watch for potential bugs.

posts.author: Radri
posts.body:
True, considering it's only a prototype to learn rpg maker stuff (for now), I think I could just try to go with the flow and make 48x48 sprites. It's still a bit of a shame the editor is locked to that size and increasing/decreasing makes it a bit annoying. But I will get to crossing that bridge when I actually will want to make someone with more significant tile size change.
